preconditions.description: The number of tasks q is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= 10**5 for u in [line.split()[1] for line in lines if line.split()[0] == '1'])
preconditions.description: For every type 1 task, the value u_i is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**5 and 1 <= k <= 10**5 and 1 <= s <= 10**5 for line in lines if line.split()[0] == '2' for x, k, s in [(int(line.split()[1]), int(line.split()[2]), int(line.split()[3]))])
preconditions.description: For every type 2 task, x_i, k_i, and s_i are between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The first task is guaranteed to be of type 1.
There is at least one task of type 2.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == len([line for line in lines if line.split()[0] == '2'])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 2 tasks.

postconditions.expression: all((v in current_array and k % math.gcd(x, v) == 0 and x + v <= s) or (v == -1 and not any((k % math.gcd(x, val) == 0 and x + val <= s) for val in current_array)) for (x, k, s, v) in zip(query_params, output_values))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query (x, k, s), the output v is either -1 (if no valid element exists in the current array satisfying the GCD and sum constraints) or a value v present in the array such that k divides GCD(x, v) and x + v <= s.

postconditions.expression: all((v == -1) or (x ^ v) == max((x ^ val) for val in current_array if k % math.gcd(x, val) == 0 and x + val <= s) for (x, k, s, v) in zip(query_params, output_values))
postconditions.description: If a valid v exists, it maximizes the value of x XOR v among all elements in the array satisfying the GCD and sum constraints.
